transcript.text: Hi, this is Austin, a virtual health insurance advisor with Darwix Health. This call is recorded for quality and compliance purposes. Is it okay if we continue?
Yes, that's fine.
Thank you. How can I help you today? I can answer questions about our health plans, or check which plan might fit you.
Hi, I'm looking for health insurance for me and my wife.
Great, I can help you explore options for you and your wife. Happy to help with that. I'll ask a few quick questions to see which plans might fit. May I ask how old you are?
Thanks for sharing your age. I can help you find a plan for you and your wife. Which state do you live in?
We live in Austin, Texas.
Thanks for letting me know you’re in Texas. I can help you find a plan that fits you and your wife. How many people would need coverage, including you?
Just the two of us.
Thanks for letting me know you’re a two‑person household. I can help you find a plan that fits you and your wife. Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
How much does the Family Shield plan cost?

Just so you know, final coverage and premiums are subject to medical underwriting and depend on verified medical history. The Family Shield plan starts at about $520 per month for a family of two. Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?
No, neither of us smokes.

Thanks for confirming you and your wife do not use tobacco. I can proceed with the next steps to help you get a quote for the Family Shield plan. Do you, or anyone who would be covered, have any current medical conditions? You're welcome to skip this one.
No, we're both healthy.
Thanks for letting me know you’re both healthy. I’ll move forward with the quote for the Family Shield plan. Do you have any health insurance right now?
No, I lost my coverage when I left my job.
I’m sorry to hear you lost coverage. I can help you get a new plan. What's the best time for a licensed advisor to call you back with a quote?
Weekday evenings after 6 would be best.

Got it, weekday evenings after 6 works. A licensed advisor will call you then to discuss the Family Shield plan and next steps. And do I have your permission for Darwix Health to contact you about your quote?
Yes, that's fine.

Thank you for giving permission. A licensed advisor will call you on weekday evenings after 6 to discuss the Family Shield plan and next steps. Thank you, that's everything I need. Based on what you've told me, you may be a fit for Essential Care or Family Shield. A licensed advisor will call you with a personalized quote. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's all. Thanks!
Thank you for confirming. A licensed advisor will call you on weekday evenings after 6 to discuss the Family Shield or Essential Care plans. Have a great day!
